record_hint: Use the MCP tools ux_record_decision, ux_record_impression, ux_record_vision_review, ux_record_reconcile, ux_record_read, ux_record_insight and ux_record_song_receipt (or `python -m ux_creator record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with ux_records_search / ux_records_digest.
